about_the_game: Immerse yourself in the haunting ambiance of the mansion with this original soundtrack, composed by Daniel Alvarez Veroy. Each track has been meticulously crafted to capture the dark, unsettling, desolate, and mysterious atmosphere that pervades every corridor and chamber. Experience the dread and intrigue of the mansion like never before, as every note draws you deeper into its foreboding world.
